run6_run7_run8_summary.interpretation_for_research_prompt: Two OVR-BCE runs improved or preserved strong monitor checkpoint scores while both regressed held-out verification recall; run8 lowered OVR-BCE weight but worsened held-out recall further, making another blind OVR-BCE paid run inappropriate.

gpt_pro_web_attempt.details: tool_search was queried for Browser/iab ChatGPT control, but the exposed callable tools in this session did not include an in-app Browser/iab control route for ChatGPT.com Pro.

diagnosis: Reducing OVR-BCE from 0.03 to 0.01 did not fix the held-out regression, so the failure is unlikely to be only auxiliary-loss magnitude.
The likely failure is objective or checkpoint-selection mismatch: OVR-BCE improves monitor-side false-positive behavior while damaging held-out true-class positive margins or calibration.
Top-1 improved while top-5 and verification recall regressed, so argmax accuracy is not diagnosing the MVP per-word verification failure.
After two negative held-out OVR-BCE results, OVR-BCE should be stopped for now and run6 should remain the running-best base.

selected_no_brev_diagnostic.summary: Run one local run6/run7/run8 verification calibration-tail and checkpoint-selection audit across monitor and held-out test splits.
required_outputs: overall verification recall@FAR10 for each run and split
per-class verification recall and FAR10 thresholds
non-target softmax quantiles near threshold p90/p95/max
positive margin quantiles where margin = p_true_class - threshold
per-class deltas run7-run6, run8-run6, and run8-run7
classes regressing by more than 0.05 recall and whether lower positive margins, higher thresholds, both, or boundary sensitivity explains them
monitor-vs-test transfer table with monitor best score, test score, monitor-test gap, best checkpoint epoch, and final monitor score
top failure words for runs 6, 7, and 8
pass_criteria: No Brev lifecycle command is run.
No optimizer step or backward pass occurs.
No checkpoint, model export, or browser/runtime artifact is written or promoted.
No raw learner video is uploaded.
No pretrained runtime dependency is introduced.
No raw test-mined pairs are used as training supervision.
Run6 held-out verification recall reproduces within +/-0.001.
Run7 and run8 held-out verification recall reproduce within expected CPU/GPU threshold-boundary tolerance, no wider than +/-0.002 unless explicitly justified by class-level boundary flips.
Per-class margin, threshold, and recall deltas are produced for all 95 classes or missing classes are explicitly documented.
The audit identifies whether run8's added regression versus run7 is mostly broader positive-margin damage, worse thresholds, different affected classes, later checkpoint selection, or unresolved.
fail_criteria: Any training, backward, checkpoint, export, browser promotion, raw upload, pretrained runtime dependency, final-gate change, or Brev lifecycle occurs.
Authoritative run metrics cannot be reproduced within the stated tolerances or documented boundary-flip exception.
The audit cannot explain or classify the run8-vs-run7 regression mode.
The audit tries to use held-out test-mined pairs as training supervision.

future_paid_recipe.reason: Run7 and run8 both show OVR-BCE can improve monitor selection while worsening held-out verification recall. Another paid variant before a three-run calibration-tail and checkpoint-selection audit risks repeating the same monitor-overfit pattern.
future_paid_recipe.likely_future_direction_after_audit: Return to the run6 base and choose a minimal calibration-safe change only after the audit identifies whether checkpoint selection, positive-margin compression, threshold inflation, or another cause dominates.

brev_auth_prerequisite.reason: Run8 teardown lost Brev CLI auth and could not verify final workspace state through Brev; future compute must first recover auth and verify worker visibility.

next_action.summary: Implement or reuse a local no-training calibration-tail and checkpoint-selection audit comparing run6, run7, and run8 before selecting any further paid recognizer recipe.
